1.?

To calculate the sum of an arithmetic series, we use the formula SN=N2(a1+aN), where a1 is the first term, aN is the last term, and N is the number of terms.

For our series, we have a1=−9,aN=−33 and N=13. Substituting these values into the formula for SN, we obtain:

S13=132(−9+(−33))=132(−42)=13(−21)=−273
